title: When LLMs Sit Above Diagnostic Tools: Unrealized Complementarity in Industrial Fault Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2610.05031v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as integration layers above specialized tools, but a stronger component does not necessarily produce a stronger combined system. Across five diagnostic datasets (bearing vibration, process monitoring, semiconductor equipment), we study whether an LLM can reliably use external diagnostic information; paired repeat calls separate advice effects from output instability. In all five, conflicting external information overturned initially correct LLM judgments. Among the four datasets with direct integration comparisons, none showed a consistent advantage for implicit LLM integration over the stronger standalone source. On a Tennessee Eastman confirmation set whose protocol was fixed before evaluation, unaided accuracy was 64.67%, implicit LLM-specialist integration 77.43%, and the specialist alone 83.33%. translated_title: 当大语言模型凌驾于诊断工具之上：工业故障诊断中未实现的互补性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用作专业工具之上的集成层，但更强的组件并不一定带来更强的组合系统。我们在五个诊断数据集（轴承振动、过程监控、半导体设备）上研究了LLM能否可靠地利用外部诊断信息；通过成对的重复调用，将建议效应与输出不稳定性分离开来。在所有五个数据集中，相互冲突的外部信息均会推翻LLM最初正确的判断。在四个进行直接集成比较的数据集中，没有一个显示出隐式LLM集成相对于更强的独立数据源具有持续优势。在一个评估协议预先固定的田纳西-伊士曼确认数据集上，无辅助准确率为64.67%，隐式LLM-专家集成为77.43%，而单独使用专家工具则为83.33%。专家信息将LLM的性能提升了12.8个百分点（95%区间为9.7至15.9），然而……
tldr: 该研究发现在工业故障诊断中，大语言模型与专业诊断工具的集成并未实现真正的互补性——外部专家信息虽能提升LLM表现（最高提升12.8个百分点），但集成系统仍不及最强的独立专业工具，且冲突信息甚至会推翻LLM原本正确的判断。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that LLM integration with specialized diagnostic tools in industrial fault diagnosis fails to realize true complementarity—while expert information improves LLM performance by up to 12.8 points, the integrated system still underperforms the strongest standalone specialist tool, and conflicting external information can overturn the LLM's initially correct judgments.
